statement: No existing work directly evaluates whether adding a temporal relevance component improves answer accuracy for open-domain question answering over versioned regulatory documents with overlapping revisions and time-stamped queries; TempRALM is evaluated on a tennis grand slam dataset (p. 5) and Re3 introduces Re2Bench for general temporal information retrieval (abstract).

evidence.quote: In particular, we curated a dataset based on tennis grand slam data, where 4 major tournaments take place every year and answers to the queries depend on when the query is asked, with respect to the timing of the tournament.
To address this gap, we introduce Re2Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to disentangle and evaluate Relevance, Recency, and their hybrid combination.
